change_request.title: Fix X-Opaque-Id header propagation (along with other response headers) for streaming Reactor Netty 4 transport
change_request.author: reta

task.task: Fix X-Opaque-Id and other response-header propagation in streaming Reactor Netty 4 transport, and safely deliver responses produced before subscription.
subtasks: Enrich DefaultStreamingRestChannel responses with ThreadContext response headers and the request's X-Opaque-Id, including non-streaming failure responses sent through the streaming channel.
Only prepare Reactor Netty streaming response status and headers while headers have not yet been sent.

Buffer response content until the streaming emitter is ready, retaining listeners and final-content markers; drain on subscription and fail with IllegalStateException when more than 64 messages are buffered.
Add StreamingRequest.setOptions overloads for RequestOptions and RequestOptions.Builder, rejecting null inputs.
Expose all response headers and first-header lookup on StreamingResponse, including headers from ResponseException responses; return null for missing headers.
Add streaming bulk integration tests verifying X-Opaque-Id echo, successful delivery and indexing of five records, and a 400 ResponseException for duplicate X-Opaque-Id headers.
Record the streaming response-header propagation fix in the changelog.

change_request.title: Fix ProfileScorer.getChildren() to expose wrapped scorer in scorer tree
change_request.author: martin-gaievski

task.task: Provide a public, generic ProfilingWrapper interface so plugins can access delegates of profiling decorators without reflection, while preserving ProfileScorer.getChildren() delegation.
subtasks: Add org.opensearch.search.profile.ProfilingWrapper<T> with T getDelegate(), mark it @PublicApi(since = "3.6.0"), and document plugin detection and unwrapping.
Implement ProfilingWrapper<Scorer> on ProfileScorer and replace getWrappedScorer() with getDelegate(); implement ProfilingWrapper<Collector> on ProfileCollector using its existing delegate accessor.

Implement ProfilingWrapper<Aggregator> on ProfilingAggregator and ProfilingWrapper<LeafBucketCollector> on ProfilingLeafBucketCollector, returning the original delegates; make the leaf bucket collector delegate final.

Add tests verifying delegate identity, interface-based scorer access, nested scorer unwrapping from a Scorable reference, and unchanged getChildren() delegation; verify aggregator and leaf bucket collector wrapper access.
Update the changelog to describe the ProfilingWrapper interface for plugin access to profiling delegates.

change_request.title: Add IT for field mapper type for pull-based ingestion
change_request.author: imRishN

task.task: Add Kafka integration coverage for the field_mapping mapper in pull-based ingestion and validate numeric version fields.
subtasks: Validate the trimmed version_field value with Long.parseLong before mapping it to _version; throw IllegalArgumentException identifying the field and invalid value when parsing fails.
Add mapper unit tests confirming that nonnumeric strings and boolean version values are rejected with the expected error message.
Add Kafka integration tests using raw JSON messages to verify configured document ID extraction, preservation of document content, and removal of extracted metadata fields from _source.
Test index-then-delete ingestion and out-of-order external versions, asserting final document state, processed-message counts, and version-conflict counts.
Cover create_value mapping with default indexing for other values, minimal id_field-only configuration, and a custom Y/N delete_value convention.

change_request.title: Allow slash in snapshot file name validation
change_request.author: xuxiong1

task.task: Allow safe relative path-like physical file names in blob store snapshots while rejecting absolute paths, path traversal, and other invalid filename characters.
subtasks: Add Strings.validFileNameExcludingSlash() to allow forward and backslashes, reject names starting with either separator, reject '..' path segments using either separator, and preserve rejection of other INVALID_FILENAME_CHARS.
Update BlobStoreIndexShardSnapshot.FileInfo.fromXContent() to use the new validator for physicalName only, retaining strict validation for name and existing parse errors.
Rename validFileNameExcludingAstrix() to validFileNameExcludingAsterisk() and update its callers in RemoveByPatternProcessor and MetadataIndexTemplateService.
Add StringsTests coverage for ordinary filenames, relative paths with forward, back, and mixed separators, absolute paths, traversal segments, and other invalid characters.
Add FileInfoTests coverage confirming that relative slash-containing physical names parse successfully and that absolute paths and traversal names throw OpenSearchParseException.

change_request.title: Improve exception messaging when encountering legacy version IDs
change_request.author: msfroh

task.task: Improve unsupported legacy version errors so opening or upgrading an Elasticsearch-created index reports a readable version and explains why the index is unsupported.
subtasks: Add a documented Version.UnsupportedVersionException with a readable version accessor. Make Version.fromId throw it for nonzero IDs without the OpenSearch mask, formatting legacy IDs such as 7090199 as ES 7.9.1.

Catch UnsupportedVersionException in IndexMetadata.indexCreated and wrap it in an IllegalArgumentException stating that the index UUID and creation version are not supported by the current OpenSearch version, preserving the original cause.
Add regression tests verifying legacy version decoding and rejection of index metadata with a legacy creation version, including the preserved exception cause.
Replace Version.stringHasLength with core Strings.hasLength in Version and SemverRange, and remove the redundant helper.
Add a changelog entry describing the improved error message.

change_request.title: Validation of the `_source` object in request and deprecation of ambiguous usage
change_request.author: urmichm

task.task: Validate contradictory `_source` filters and deprecate ambiguous empty forms while preserving existing source-fetching behavior.
subtasks: Add constructor-level validation in FetchSourceContext that rejects identical entries in includes and excludes with IllegalArgumentException and the message: "The same entry [<entry>] cannot be both included and excluded in _source."

Emit deprecation warnings for `_source: {}`, `_source: []`, and explicitly empty includes or excludes arrays without changing their filtering behavior; recommend boolean `_source` values for fetching or omitting the entire source.
Harden array parsing to accept only strings, deduplicate entries while preserving order, validate expected parser tokens, and report all supported `_source` value types in parsing errors.
Update XContent serialization to emit false when source fetching is disabled, true when enabled without filters, and otherwise an object containing only nonempty includes and excludes arrays.

Add unit tests for supported forms, duplicate removal, empty-form warnings, conflicting filters, and invalid parser input; extend gRPC conversion tests and version-gated REST YAML tests to verify conflict rejection as HTTP 400 and unchanged filtering results.

task.task: Fix FlightOutboundHandler so asynchronous response dispatch preserves the caller's ThreadContext, propagates it to the executor, and restores the executor's original context after execution.
subtasks: Wrap executor lambdas in sendResponseBatch(), completeStream(), and sendErrorResponse() with threadPool.getThreadContext().preserveContext() instead of capturing context with stashContext().
Remove manual storedContext.restore() calls from task-processing methods and remove the StoredContext field and cleanup from BatchTask, retaining channel-release behavior.
Update BatchTask construction sites, including FlightTransportChannelTests, to match the simplified record signature.
Add unit tests covering caller-context preservation for all three dispatch methods, context propagation to the executor, and preservation across multiple batch sends followed by stream completion.

Add integration tests using FlightTransport and StreamTransportService to verify context preservation through streaming batches, completion, and error responses, along with successful batch delivery and response-sent notifications.

change_request.title: Add skeleton structure for tiering status API
change_request.author: GeekGlider

task.task: Add the server-core skeleton for tiering status APIs under org.opensearch.storage.action.tiering.status, without implementing status retrieval or wiring TieringService dependencies.
subtasks: Define GetTieringStatusAction and ListTieringStatusAction with singleton instances, response readers, and action names indices:admin/_tier/get and cluster:admin/_tier/all.

Add cluster-manager read request models for a single index with a detailed flag defaulting to false, and for listing statuses with an optional target tier normalized using Locale.ROOT; add corresponding response models.
Define TieringStatus fields and response-key constants for index, state, source, target, start time, shard counters, and relocation details, including nested ShardLevelStatus and OngoingShard models.
Add RestGetTieringStatusAction for GET /{index}/_tier and a CAT-style RestListTieringStatusAction for GET /_tier/all, declaring detailed, index, and target parameter constants.
Add TransportGetTieringStatusAction and TransportListTieringStatusAction extending TransportClusterManagerNodeReadAction with standard injected transport dependencies.

Leave serialization, deserialization, XContent rendering, REST execution, and transport operation hooks as UnsupportedOperationException("Not yet implemented") placeholders; defer service wiring and tests to implementation work.
Add package documentation and a changelog entry for the tiering status API skeleton.

change_request.title: Add changes for introducing lucene committer in data format aware engine
change_request.author: alchemist51

task.task: Introduce a pluggable Committer abstraction and Lucene-backed implementation for durable catalog snapshot persistence, wiring shared Lucene writer access into the data-format-aware and composite engines.
subtasks: Add experimental Committer, CommitterConfig, CommitterFactory, and IndexStoreProvider APIs, plus an optional committer factory hook on EnginePlugin and committer accessors on DataFormatAwareEngine. Use constructor-based initialization rather than a separate init method.

Introduce IndexingEngineConfig and ReaderManagerConfig, including an optional store provider for readers. Update plugin interfaces, registries, factories, DataFusion, Parquet, composite components, and test stubs to use these configuration records; defer reader-manager creation until a provider can be supplied.

Implement LuceneCommitter and its factory to own the IndexWriter lifecycle on the shard Store, apply available EngineConfig writer settings, manage Store references, persist commit metadata, expose commit statistics and package-private writer access, and reject operations after closure. Leave safe-commit support explicitly unsupported.

Add LuceneIndexingExecutionEngine backed by LuceneCommitter. During refresh, incorporate existing directories named lucene using addIndexes, close directory handles, and remove processed source directories. Expose the store provider while leaving deferred writer, document-input, and data-format functionality unimplemented.

Replace LuceneSearchEnginePlugin with LucenePlugin and update the build entry point. Create NRT readers from the shared writer when a Lucene indexing provider is available, otherwise read from the provider's Store; reject a missing provider. Update LuceneReaderManager to refresh and retain readers by catalog snapshot, handle duplicate refreshes, and close readers on snapshot deletion. Remove reader lookup from CatalogSnapshot.

Require a committer in CompositeIndexingExecutionEngine and pass it to delegate engines. Add flush support that acquires the latest catalog snapshot, combines its user data with its serialized representation, commits the metadata, and releases the snapshot reference. Keep refresh separate from commit, delegate store-provider access to the primary engine, and log committer-close failures without interrupting shutdown.

Add and update tests for committer contracts and accessors, Lucene writer lifecycle and metadata round trips, segment incorporation and format filtering, snapshot reader refresh/deletion behavior, missing dependencies, and composite flush, refresh separation, and shutdown error handling.

change_request.title: Make stale segments cleanup logic depend on map size as well
change_request.author: rayshrey

task.task: Prevent unbounded remote-store uploaded-segment map growth by triggering stale segment cleanup when its size exceeds a configurable threshold, while preserving cleanup on the first refresh after a commit.
subtasks: Add and register the dynamic, node-scoped setting `cluster.remote_store.uploaded_segments_cleanup_threshold` with a default of 1000, valid values from 100 through 100000 inclusive, and -1 to disable threshold-based cleanup. Expose its current value through RemoteStoreSettings and support runtime updates.

Expose the uploaded-segment map size from RemoteSegmentStoreDirectory. Update RemoteStoreRefreshListener to invoke existing asynchronous stale segment cleanup when the map size is strictly greater than the enabled threshold or on the first refresh after a commit, retaining the configured metadata retention count.
Add tests for repeated refreshes without flushes, verifying cleanup limits map growth when enabled and that the map grows when threshold-based cleanup is disabled.
Test the setting’s default, dynamic updates, disabling value, inclusive boundaries, and rejection of invalid values.
Add a changelog entry for the remote-store stale segment cleanup fix.
